ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and the Sun at {H:1821891680000}

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1821877229000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.
